newsitem.title: UK: N.Ireland police find explosive - security sources.
newsitem.headline: N.Ireland police find explosive - security sources.

text.p: Northern Ireland police on Sunday found a substantial amount of home-made explosive in a search of a Catholic housing estate in Londonderry, security sources said.
They said three containers were found at the rear of a house and examined by army bomb disposal experts.
Houses were evacuated during the operation, which began on Sunday afternoon, residents said.

Home-made explosives are a favoured weapon of the Irish Republican Army, which is fighting British rule of Northern Ireland. The province has been tense in recent weeks as it neared the height of the traditional marching season by pro-British Protestant "Loyalists".
Londonderry, Northern Ireland's second city, is a stronghold of Catholic Irish nationalists.
